name: copilotkit
summary: I successfully scaffolded a Next.js app, installed `@copilotkit/react-core` and `@copilotkit/runtime`, and wired up the Copilot Runtime API route and frontend provider per the CopilotKit quickstart pattern. The dev server started and the copilot endpoint demonstrably responded: `curl http://localhost:3000/api/copilotkit/info` returned valid JSON showing `{"version":"1.69.3","agents":{"default":{...}},"mode":"sse"}`. I could not fetch the vendor's quickstart page directly because `docs.copilotkit.ai` was blocked by sandbox network policy ("Internet is restricted on Tier 1 and Tier 2"), so I had to reconstruct the steps from the installed packages. The `next build` was OOM-killed (exit 137), and the root `/` curl returned empty, likely because the dev process was terminated before the page finished compiling.

installed.evidence: added 1166 packages, and audited 1532 packages in 1m
